About Aptos

Aptos is a layer-1 blockchain built with the Move language by former Diem engineers, designed for parallel transaction execution. APT pays gas and secures the network through staking.

Where this APT price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (APT-USD), Binance (APT/USDT) and Kraken (APT/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 701,954,000 APT (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
